headline: AIRS Medical has received FDA clearance for AI software that measures body fat, muscle and liver fat from an MRI scan.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: an FDA clearance for a specialist imaging tool, announced by the maker with no performance data.
importance_line: People wanting to track body fat, muscle and liver fat for weight management or healthy aging could get the measurements from a short MRI scan at centers that adopt the software, but this is the maker's own announcement with no accuracy data, and clearance rests on similarity to an existing device, not proof of better health.
source: AIRS Medical, in a press release carried by PR Newswire
summary: AIRS Medical, an MRI software company, said in a PR Newswire release that the US Food and Drug Administration has granted 510(k) clearance (the route for devices shown to be similar to existing ones) to SwiftSight Body Composition, AI software that measures muscle, fat and liver fat from an MRI scan of under five minutes. The company says results are compared with age- and sex-matched reference groups and that SimonMed Imaging will be the first customer, but the announcement gives no accuracy figures.
